reviews.text:
Quack! You enter a nice shop, but behind it is his messy consulting room. He doesn't even look at your dog but immediately launches into a complicated discourse about intestines and the cure that needs to be administered by him, even before he has examined the dog. Consultation cost 200. Cure cost 500 per month with 5 supplements at 45 each, and it is unclear what this has to do with your dog. The fact that there is a jar of dog biscuits on his desk with maggots crawling through it out of misery doesn't bother him, but it made it clear to us that he does not have the best interests of our beloved pets' health at heart.

So do not go to this man; totally unreliable!

I took the dog for the first time to have his nails trimmed. Unfortunately, my dog ​​has a lot of trouble with that, but they helped me really well and took their time! They also charged very reasonable prices! I will definitely be back.

We visited Stefan a while ago with our brown Labrador (Sjef). After months of on-and-off diarrhea and having to get up at night, we were really fed up after an overnight stay at the veterinary hospital and wanted to try something different (than conventional veterinary medicine). We followed the full intestinal protocol at Natuurlijk Gezonde Dieren and switched to BARF food. Sjef is now a healthy young dog, who unfortunately still occasionally eats trash/poop off the street, but thankfully doesn't get as sick from it anymore. His immune system is much better and medication is no longer necessary. For us, it was all worth it.
Thank you Claudia, see you soon!

Our sweet English Bulldog, George, has had severe stomach problems since he was a puppy. He contracted a parasite and never recovered. He ate a lot, but his body wasn't absorbing any nutrients. He became thinner and thinner, even though he was in his growth stagnation. He had exhausted all his vet treatments, and we were at a loss. Then we finally found Naturally Healthy Animals, which was our greatest blessing! George was given homeopathic remedies, and everything quickly changed. He finally gained weight and was put on the right diet: raw meat with vegetables (and believe me, we had tried everything before). He is healthy and, thankfully, has started growing properly again! His coat is shiny, and he has lots of energy. We are forever grateful to Naturally Healthy Animals!

I am incredibly happy that I took two of my three cats to Stefan at ‘Natuurlijk gezonde dieren’. One of my cats, Vleugeli, is done with endless skin irritation and itchy spots that he scratched until they bled, purely through herbal remedies.

The other cat, Yoru, is well on his way to getting rid of his chronic coughing fits.
All naturally, with herbs and careful attention to his diet.
As a pet owner, it does require an investment in time, effort, patience, and interest, and yes, money too. But for me, making my sweet cats naturally healthy is more than worth it.

We have a one-and-a-half-year-old Chihuahua. Since we got him as a puppy, he has been very anxious; it is truly sad to see. We went to see Stefan, and he discovered quite a few things. It was so bad that he had actually never seen anything like this at such a young age. Stefan started treating him, and strangely enough, after just one session, we already noticed something upon returning home: Luca was very relaxed and laid-back, almost as if he were stoned. We are now 14 days into the course of many supplements, and we are noticing small improvements. We are nowhere near the end of the road yet, but we are confident that this will work out. Stefan thinks he will need about 4 or 5 months. And we have faith in Stefan, because after 14 days, we can't really expect anything yet. Stefan is a friendly vet who gives clear explanations about the situation.
My older dog was suffering from acute neck pain; thanks to acupuncture and additional support via nutritional supplements, she is back to her old self. And that after just two treatments!

An approach to veterinary medicine that should actually be self-evident to everyone — natural, conscious, and healthy. I enjoy coming here because this vision appeals to me enormously. You are truly drawn into the process and learn not only about the right treatment, but also about the how and why. An incredibly educational and pleasant experience. I can wholeheartedly recommend this center!

Durga, my kitten, had not fully recovered from her diarrhea. The same evening after the visit with Dr. Stefan, she ate better and was more cheerful. The next morning, she had no diarrhea. She received not only Chinese supplements but also an excellent energetic treatment with gold needles and a crystal. Her heart is more open and she is more cuddly.

Her health and energy have been completely restored to 200%. The results are
also long-term because this week she uses the litter box every day. She is also a very brave climber and loves to go very high up the tree! It was admirable!

I recommend having your pet treated by Dr. Stefan for a holistic treatment with faster results in the short and long term.

We visited Naturally Healthy Animals / Stefan 2 years ago because our large Labradoodle had some early signs of osteoarthritis and was a bit stiff.

We read about gold acupuncture (placing small gold pieces in the hips). After doing some research, we had this treatment done. We are only writing a review now, after 2 years, because we wanted to wait a bit. It is going incredibly well. Our dog is not in pain and frolics around happily. He turned 9 last week and sometimes he runs and acts like a young dog. We are very happy that we did this. It has really paid off.

My little dog suffered from eating grass and nausea. He could no longer tolerate raw meat or bones. After the treatment by Stefan with Chinese herbs and supplements, he is doing great, is getting delicious fresh food again, and no longer eats grass.
Dont even think about it

Wish I could leave 0 star. All bad reviews are so evident during my experience with them. A group of staff will definitely blame you not instructing them how to do their job. Slow vet with “magical magnet”, staff with no professionalism and accountability, every consultation over charged. DO AVOID THIS CLINIC.
Lots of empathy and understanding for people and animals. Thank you 🙏 …

Amazing vet🙏
Thinks along with you and looks beyond the average vets and their textbooks. …

We are currently undergoing treatment with our Labradoodle puppy, who is suffering severely from unexplained itching. Saskia is helping us very well! Hopefully, our puppy will get rid of the itching with the help of the supplements, but for now, we are very satisfied with the help we have received. Thank you, Saskia!

Our cat Daantje fell ill in March of last year; he was suspected of having cat flu. A few vet visits later, it turned out that one of his nostrils was blocked. An endoscopic examination by ENT specialist Gert ter Haar (what a wonderful doctor) was supposed to provide clarity. By then, Daantje was so ill that he could no longer eat, and we had to feed him with a syringe. Fortunately, he was operated on just in time, but he turned out to be seriously ill. The diagnosis was malignant lymphoma, and the doctor had removed a large tumor in his throat and nose. He recovered from that. However, further treatment in the form of radiation or chemotherapy was necessary to save his life. That is how we ended up at an oncologist, where we sought information. We decided to go for chemotherapy in combination with prednisolone, but Daantje's well-being came first. After the first round of chemo, we decided to stop immediately. It was too taxing for him. We continued with the prednisolone. The oncologist's prognosis was now: a few weeks to a few months. Were there any alternatives left to help our sweet cat? An internet search led us to Stefan Veenstra. After an initial consultation, he treated him using, among other things, Chinese Medicine. He indicated that there were certainly still treatment options. We were given supplements, later supplemented with Mistletoe injections. His condition improved visibly!! It is now a year later, and Stefan, thanks to your help, there is still a contented cat lying next to me who eats incredibly well, is playful and active, and is simply happy! You would almost think that he is no longer sick. Your expertise, incredible knowledge, and passion for holistic treatment are admirable. We are incredibly grateful to you.

I went to Stefan with my one-year-old cat who started vomiting excessively after almost every meal. She started losing weight, her coat wasn't shiny anymore, and her hips were weak. I'd tried everything, but it barely helped. After seeing Stefan, I got some advice and supplements. After about two weeks, the vomiting subsided. It's now been two months, and my cat is completely back to normal! She's completely recovered, her coat is super shiny again, and she's super happy again! 🥰

We had had some doubts about our dog's health for a while. She wasn't doing badly, but in waves, something happened with her health, stool, mood, and behavior that made us question things. We were feeding her kibble and had previously inquired about raw meat. This is advised against by conventional veterinarians because they already had very sensitive/restless intestines. Raw meat made it even more intensive to digest. Logical, we thought at the time. A few months ago, we went to see Stefan for a second opinion. He was able to explain the perspective of Chinese medicine to us very well and clearly, as well as the current state of our dog's body. We knew exactly what we were building towards through the steps involved. We started feeding raw meat and received supplements that were suitable for her. We are so grateful that we embarked on this journey. We have really noticed a difference in our dog; her coat is softer, her stool is much better, and we are much more connected. She seems much more open and has a much calmer overall demeanor. The process required some adjustment and an investment, but it has certainly all been worth it when we see how our dog feels now.

For my first dog, almost fourteen years ago now, I was looking for a kind, reliable veterinarian with a holistic approach and a willingness to work with natural remedies. I ended up with Stefan. My little dog was severely traumatized, rescued from a kill shelter in Spain. He was about 2.5 years old when he came to me and very anxious. Over the 12.5 years that followed, Stefan was able to help him incredibly well. The treatments and herbs always worked well. And even when he developed cancer at the end of his life and the conventional veterinarian gave him 3 months to live, he was able to enjoy his old age for another 1.5 years, partly with Stefan's support. He passed away at home on my lap, with Stefan's gentle guidance. I am incredibly grateful to Stefan for this.

After this, my partner and I moved to Drenthe. A new dog crossed our path. This time rescued from Bulgaria and 8 months old. Fortunately, it turned out by chance that Stefan had also opened a practice in Drenthe (otherwise we would have simply driven to Amsterdam!), and we were able to immediately guide him with some ailments with a deeper underlying cause. Stefan tackled it adequately, as I have come to expect from him. Within three months, our dog was completely free of ailments, cheerful, and full of energy. We look forward to a long life with this cheerful rascal and feel blessed to know that Stefan is always ready to help with his sound knowledge, wisdom, and drive to support the dog's body in the most sustainable, holistic, and natural way possible.

We ended up at Natuurlijk Gezonde Dieren after receiving advice from our usual veterinarian in April to have our 8-year-old French Bulldog, Dexter, put to sleep. X-rays revealed osteoarthritis in many places in his back, hips, and knees. Dexter was visibly struggling, was losing urine, and his hind legs were giving way. We really wanted a second opinion.

Fortunately, we were able to get an appointment at Natuurlijk Gezonde Dieren quickly after a phone call. During the first consultation with veterinarian Stefan, we received a comprehensive examination and were told what the treatment would entail. We started with a detox of various herbs with anti-inflammatory properties. This showed visible results after just 3 days. Dexter felt better, ate and drank well again, and even became playful. We were amazed.

Dexter then went with us on a week-long vacation to the Alps, and we continued the detox there. We took it easy with walking, the dog cart, etc. After 4 weeks of detox and a week of vacation, we returned for a consultation, and significant progress was observed; there was high hope that Gold Acupuncture would further aid Dexter in his recovery.

During the procedure, gold beads were inserted into the vertebrae and joints affected by osteoarthritis to treat the inflammation/irritation there. The procedure was performed under general anesthesia and took 1 hour. Dexter recovered quickly from the anesthesia, and after a few days, we saw that he was walking even better, without the strange "painful step" he had. If we had any questions, we could call or email the veterinarian immediately and received prompt advice.

During the summer vacation, we experienced for 3 weeks just how well Dexter was doing. We then went for a final consultation, where Stefan indicated that Dexter could stop taking the herbs and that the treatment had completed its work. Dexter has now been completely without any medication for several weeks and walks again as if he has gone back in time 3 years—all within 5 months.

We are incredibly happy with the result and hope that Dexter will be with us for a long time to come. We are therefore very grateful for the excellent care provided by the team at Natuurlijk Gezonde Dieren.
Bad service. Such a shame.

Last May, I took my 12-year-old Golden Retriever to Naturally Healthy Animals for my first visit. I was stuck with the regular vet, who wanted to start a treatment for early-stage osteoarthritis (she was dragging her hind leg slightly) to …

It's so nice to know that you're listened to and your dog is being properly checked. He doesn't rush off and back outside, but he takes his time and is very knowledgeable. It feels good to go there, even if it's with a sick dog.

I have had very good results with the treatments my old dog is getting.  We had an emergency and he could be seen the same day which was great. There's usually parking in front of the door, (paid). Nice shop also and nice ladies working there.  The vet is also very nice and communicates well.
A fine approach to veterinary medicine. The cause is addressed instead of treating the symptoms. Not cheap, but well worth it.

Being a client at Natuurlijk Gezonde Dieren means consciously choosing to go beyond just the conventional route for your pet. We have been visiting Stefan for years, and he is always incredibly dedicated and supportive in treating our …

Wonderful, dedicated veterinarian. And assistants.

Willem is very happy that he is allowed to eat meat again. Since it was …

During the intake with Stefan, I could easily conclude that he knows what he is talking about. Clear and easy to understand. I have just started the treatment, so I cannot yet say at this moment if it is working. I will come back to that later.
